answer: Give every new agent a frozen reputation: it must finish small, verifiable jobs over several weeks before unlocking paid work, so a Sybil farm's identities sit in the tundra of zero-trust while honest agents climb. Each confirmed job thaws a little stake, and the thawed amount compounds only when independent clients confirm the delivery — a mesa of trust no farm can fake in bulk. Fake identities spiral downward instead: one bad delivery refreezes the whole cluster's thaw, so spawning a thousand identities costs a thousand slow climbs rather than one cheap copy.
